meta.title: The Heure Society — Luxury Watches
meta.description: A private collection of Rolex, Audemars Piguet, Patek Philippe, Cartier and Richard Mille. Authenticated pieces, viewed by appointment.

hero.title: Time, kept in good company.
hero.lead: Authenticated pieces from the world's great maisons, presented privately in our office or by video call.

items.text: Every piece is inspected and verified before it is listed.

items.title: By appointment
items.text: Private viewings in our office or by live video call.

items.title: Fair offers

sell.title: Your watch deserves a fair offer.
sell.lead: Send us a few photos and the reference. We review every request personally and respond with an offer the same day.

steps.title: Tell us about your watch
steps.text: Brand, reference, condition and a few photos. It takes two minutes.

steps.title: Receive an offer
steps.text: A specialist reviews it and sends a clear, no-obligation offer the same day.

steps.title: Inspection & payment
steps.text: We authenticate the watch in person or via insured shipping, and pay immediately once verified.

consign.title: Sell at the right price, without the rush.
consign.lead: Leave your watch with us and we will sell it on your behalf to our private clientele — at a price you approve, fully insured until the day it sells.

why.title: A higher price
why.text: Selling to a collector instead of to a dealer usually means a stronger result for you.

why.title: You stay in control
why.text: We agree on the price together, and nothing is sold without your approval.

why.title: No effort on your side
why.text: Authentication, photography, listing, viewings and negotiation — we handle all of it.

steps.title: Tell us about your watch
steps.text: Send the reference, condition and a few photos.

steps.title: Agree on a price
steps.text: We study the current market and propose a sale price for your approval.

steps.title: We present it
steps.text: Your watch is authenticated, professionally photographed and offered to our clients, in a safe and insured.

steps.title: You get paid
steps.text: As soon as it sells, we pay you the agreed amount.

consign.termsNote: Commission and agreement terms are discussed privately and confirmed in writing before we receive your watch.

faq.a: We propose a price based on the current market, and you approve it. It is never changed without your agreement.

faq.q: Where is my watch while it is with us?
faq.a: Stored in a safe and insured for its full agreed value for as long as it is in our care.

faq.q: How long does it take to sell?
faq.a: It depends on the model and the price. Highly sought-after references often sell quickly; we keep you informed throughout.

faq.q: Can I take my watch back?
faq.a: Yes. You can withdraw your watch under the terms of your consignment agreement.
